The main takeaway from our work is that
the circadian rhythms are not only restricted to the adult flies but are present in larval stages too.
the expression of tim in the adult flies and larvae of WT and mutants is under the control of circadian clock and is regulated by light.

, the expression pattern of tim in WT and mutants under LD and BD conditions is similar and it is not the light intensity that is important for the synchronization of circadian rhythm, rather it is the photoreceptors that are important for the synchronization.
